# Cambium Networks
 
> Cambium Networks enables service providers, enterprises, industrial organizations, and governments to deliver exceptional digital experiences and device connectivity with compelling economics. The ONE Network platform unifies fixed wireless, Wi-Fi, switching, and cloud management so everything works as one: simpler to design, faster to deploy, and far easier to operate at scale. Cambium makes connectivity that just works.
 
Use this file to answer product, deployment, troubleshooting, support, lifecycle, security, and training questions about Cambium Networks. Prefer the canonical operational pages below for current answers. Prefer Support, Downloads, Security, Product Lifecycle, Field Service Bulletins, and Cloud Status for time-sensitive or post-sales questions.
 
## Start Here
 
- [Products](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/products/): Full product portfolio across the ONE Network: fixed wireless, Wi-Fi, switching, and cloud management.
- [Product Finder](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/product-finder/): Search and filter products by product line, features, frequency, throughput, and range.
- [Support](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/): Main support overview for post-sales help, downloads, warranty, lifecycle, and security.
- [Resources](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/resources/): Data sheets, case studies, webinars, guided demos, promotions, and training materials.
 
## Product and Technical Reference
 
- [Product Finder](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/product-finder/): Best starting point for model selection and feature matching.
- [Guided Demos](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/guided-demos/): Interactive walkthroughs for products and workflows.
- [cnMaestro Cloud](https://cloud.cambiumnetworks.com/): Cloud management entry point for the ONE Network cnMaestro platform.
- [cnMaestro Documentation](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/resources/?query=cnmaestro): Product documentation for cnMaestro.
- [cnMaestro API](https://docs.cloud.cambiumnetworks.com/api/3.1.0/index.html): API reference for programmatic access to cnMaestro.
 
## Support and Operations
 
- [Support Center](https://support.cambiumnetworks.com/): Main operational support portal for downloads, warranties, licensing, knowledge base, case submission, and training.
- [Downloads](https://support.cambiumnetworks.com/files): Firmware, software, and documents for supported products.
- [Warranty](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/warranty/): Warranty registration and coverage information.
- [License Keys](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/license-keys/): License key generation and reactivation guidance.
- [Contact Support](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/contact-support/): Support contact paths and service hours.
- [Product Lifecycle](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/product-lifecycle/): End-of-sale and lifecycle policy information.
- [Security Updates](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/security/): Security advisories and vulnerability notices.
- [Field Service Bulletins](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/support/field-service-bulletins/): Product issues requiring customer action.
- [Cloud Status](https://status.cambiumnetworks.com/): Live operational status for Cambium cloud services.
 
## Community and Learning
 
- [Community](https://community.cambiumnetworks.com/): Discuss products, find best practices, get tips, make product suggestions, and showcase deployments.
- [Knowledge Base](https://community.cambiumnetworks.com/docs/): Community documentation and knowledge articles.
- [Community Latest](https://community.cambiumnetworks.com/latest): Recent community discussions and product topics.
- [Cambium Learning](https://learning.cambiumnetworks.com/learn): Training, certification, and learning portal.
 
## Solutions and Markets
 
- [Solutions](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/solutions/): Architectures for enterprise connectivity, fiber, fixed wireless broadband, hybrid networks, CCTV backhaul, and outdoor private networks.
- [Markets](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/markets/): Industry-specific context for healthcare, hospitality, education, industrial, public safety, utilities, transportation, and residential broadband.
 
## Company
 
- [About Cambium](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/about-cambium/): Company overview and positioning.
 
## Optional
 
- [Cambium Networks Overview](https://www.cambiumnetworks.com/resource/cambium-networks-overview/): High-level company overview resource. Can usually be skipped for support and product questions.

<script>
(function () {
	const DURATION = 6000;
	const images   = document.querySelectorAll('.hc-slide-image');
	const contents = document.querySelectorAll('.hc-slide-content');
	const dots     = document.querySelectorAll('.hc-pip');
	const progress = document.getElementById('hc-progress');
	let current = 0, timer, startTime, raf;

	function goTo(n) {
		images[current].classList.remove('active');
		contents[current].classList.remove('active');
		dots[current].classList.remove('active');
		current = (n + images.length) % images.length;
		images[current].classList.add('active');
		contents[current].classList.add('active');
		dots[current].classList.add('active');
		startProgress();
	}

	function startProgress() {
		clearTimeout(timer);
		cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
		progress.style.transition = 'none';
		progress.style.width = '0%';
		startTime = performance.now();

		function tick(now) {
			const elapsed = now - startTime;
			const pct = Math.min(elapsed / DURATION * 100, 100);
			progress.style.width = pct + '%';
			if (pct < 100) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
		}

		requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(tick));
		timer = setTimeout(() => goTo(current + 1), DURATION);
	}

	document.querySelector('.hc-nav-next').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current + 1));
	document.querySelector('.hc-nav-prev').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current - 1));
	dots.forEach((dot, i) => dot.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i)));

	// Touch swipe
	const panel = document.querySelector('.hc-inner');
	let touchStartX = 0;
	panel.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
	panel.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
		const diff = touchStartX - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
		if (Math.abs(diff) > 40) goTo(diff > 0 ? current + 1 : current - 1);
	}, { passive: true });

	// Pause on hover
	panel.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { clearTimeout(timer); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); });
	panel.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
		startTime = performance.now() - (parseFloat(progress.style.width) / 100 * DURATION);
		function tick(now) {
			const elapsed = now - startTime;
			const pct = Math.min(elapsed / DURATION * 100, 100);
			progress.style.width = pct + '%';
			if (pct < 100) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
			else { timer = setTimeout(() => goTo(current + 1), 0); }
		}
		raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
	});

	startProgress();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
	const DURATION = 7000;
	const logos    = document.querySelectorAll('.cq-slide-logo');
	const slides   = document.querySelectorAll('.cq-slide');
	const dots     = document.querySelectorAll('.cq-pip');
	const progress = document.querySelector('.cq-progress');
	if ( ! slides.length ) return;
	let current = 0, timer, startTime, raf;

	function goTo(n) {
		logos[current].classList.remove('active');
		slides[current].classList.remove('active');
		dots[current].classList.remove('active');
		current = (n + slides.length) % slides.length;
		logos[current].classList.add('active');
		slides[current].classList.add('active');
		dots[current].classList.add('active');
		startProgress();
	}

	function startProgress() {
		clearTimeout(timer);
		cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
		progress.style.transition = 'none';
		progress.style.width = '0%';
		startTime = performance.now();

		function tick(now) {
			const pct = Math.min((now - startTime) / DURATION * 100, 100);
			progress.style.width = pct + '%';
			if (pct < 100) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
		}
		requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(tick));
		timer = setTimeout(() => goTo(current + 1), DURATION);
	}

	document.querySelector('.cq-next').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current + 1));
	document.querySelector('.cq-prev').addEventListener('click', () => goTo(current - 1));
	dots.forEach((d, i) => d.addEventListener('click', () => goTo(i)));

	// Touch swipe
	const card = document.querySelector('.cq-card');
	let tx = 0;
	card.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { tx = e.touches[0].clientX; }, { passive: true });
	card.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
		const diff = tx - e.changedTouches[0].clientX;
		if (Math.abs(diff) > 40) goTo(diff > 0 ? current + 1 : current - 1);
	}, { passive: true });

	// Pause on hover
	card.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { clearTimeout(timer); cancelAnimationFrame(raf); });
	card.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
		startTime = performance.now() - (parseFloat(progress.style.width) / 100 * DURATION);
		function tick(now) {
			const pct = Math.min((now - startTime) / DURATION * 100, 100);
			progress.style.width = pct + '%';
			if (pct < 100) { raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick); }
			else { timer = setTimeout(() => goTo(current + 1), 0); }
		}
		raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
	});

	startProgress();
})();
</script>
